entries.definition_en: something you ask to get an answer
entries.example_en: Can I ask you a question?
entries.example_vi: Mình hỏi bạn một câu được không?
entries.cloze_en: Can I ask you a question? What is your name?

entries.definition_en: a thing you write with using ink
entries.example_en: Can I borrow your pen, please?
entries.example_vi: Cho mình mượn bút của bạn nhé?
entries.cloze_en: I write my name with a blue pen.

entries.definition_en: to move very fast on your feet
entries.example_en: We run around the school yard every morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nào tụi mình cũng chạy quanh sân trường.
entries.cloze_en: I am late for school, so I run very fast.

entries.definition_en: to notice something with your eyes
entries.example_en: I can see the sea from my window.
entries.example_vi: Từ cửa sổ mình nhìn thấy biển.
entries.cloze_en: I can see the sea from my window.

entries.definition_en: a round thing you throw, kick or hit in games
entries.example_en: Throw the ball to me!
entries.example_vi: Ném bóng cho mình đi!
entries.cloze_en: We play soccer with a ball.

entries.definition_en: to do the school work that teachers give you for home
entries.example_en: I do homework after dinner every day.
entries.example_vi: Ngày nào mình cũng làm bài tập sau bữa tối.
entries.cloze_en: After school, I do homework and then watch TV.

entries.definition_en: pages with words and pictures that you read
entries.example_en: I read a book before bed.
entries.example_vi: Mình đọc sách trước khi ngủ.
entries.cloze_en: I read a book about animals before bed.

entries.definition_en: to make a picture with a pen or pencil
entries.example_en: My little sister likes to draw cats.
entries.example_vi: Em gái mình thích vẽ mèo.
entries.cloze_en: My little sister likes to draw cats with her pencils.

entries.definition_en: not hard to do or understand
entries.example_en: The first question is very easy.
entries.example_vi: Câu hỏi đầu tiên rất dễ.
entries.cloze_en: This math question is very easy. Everyone knows the answer.

entries.definition_en: an activity you play for fun, with rules
entries.example_en: We play a word game in English class.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình chơi trò chơi từ vựng trong giờ tiếng Anh.
entries.cloze_en: We play a word game in English class.

entries.definition_en: to have information in your head
entries.example_en: Do you know the answer?
entries.example_vi: Bạn có biết câu trả lời không?
entries.cloze_en: Do you know the answer to this question?

entries.definition_en: to turn your eyes toward something
entries.example_en: Look at the board, please.
entries.example_vi: Các em nhìn lên bảng nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Look at this photo. It's my family.

entries.definition_en: the study of numbers and shapes
entries.example_en: Math is my favorite subject.
entries.example_vi: Toán là môn mình thích nhất.
entries.cloze_en: In math class, we learn that two and two is four.

entries.definition_en: to do something for fun, like a game or sport
entries.example_en: The children play in the school yard.
entries.example_vi: Bọn trẻ chơi ở sân trường.
entries.cloze_en: The children play soccer in the school yard.

entries.definition_en: to look at words and understand them
entries.example_en: My mom reads me a story every night.
entries.example_vi: Tối nào mẹ cũng đọc truyện cho mình nghe.
entries.cloze_en: My mom likes to read me a story every night.

entries.definition_en: to make music with your voice
entries.example_en: We sing a song for our teacher.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình hát tặng cô giáo một bài.
entries.cloze_en: At the party, we sing a happy song for our teacher.

entries.definition_en: to travel to school to study
entries.example_en: I go to school at seven in the morning.
entries.example_vi: Mình đi học lúc bảy giờ sáng.
entries.cloze_en: From Monday to Friday, I go to school at seven in the morning.

entries.definition_en: a short piece of music with words
entries.example_en: This is my favorite song.
entries.example_vi: Đây là bài hát mình thích nhất.
entries.cloze_en: This is my favorite song. I sing it every day.

entries.definition_en: a group of letters with a meaning
entries.example_en: I learn ten new English words every day.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi ngày mình học mười từ tiếng Anh mới.
entries.cloze_en: "Cat" is a short English word with three letters.

entries.definition_en: a group of students who learn together
entries.example_en: There are thirty students in my class.
entries.example_vi: Lớp mình có ba mươi học sinh.
entries.cloze_en: There are thirty students in my class.

entries.definition_en: to get new knowledge or a new skill
entries.example_en: I want to learn how to swim.
entries.example_vi: Mình muốn học bơi.
entries.cloze_en: I want to learn how to swim this summer.

entries.definition_en: a story shown with moving pictures
entries.example_en: We watch a funny movie on Saturday night.
entries.example_vi: Tối thứ Bảy tụi mình xem một bộ phim hài.
entries.cloze_en: We watch a funny movie at the cinema on Saturday night.

entries.definition_en: sounds made by voices or instruments
entries.example_en: My brother listens to music all day.
entries.example_vi: Anh mình nghe nhạc cả ngày.
entries.cloze_en: My brother listens to music on his phone all day.

entries.definition_en: a picture you take with a camera
entries.example_en: Let's take a photo together!
entries.example_vi: Mình chụp chung một tấm ảnh nhé!
entries.cloze_en: Smile! I want to take a photo of you with my phone.

entries.definition_en: a game like soccer or swimming that you play for exercise
entries.example_en: Soccer is the most popular sport in Vietnam.
entries.example_vi: Bóng đá là môn thể thao phổ biến nhất ở Việt Nam.
entries.cloze_en: Soccer is my favorite sport. I play it every day.

entries.definition_en: to spend time learning about a subject
entries.example_en: I study for my math test tonight.
entries.example_vi: Tối nay mình học bài cho bài kiểm tra toán.
entries.cloze_en: I have a math test tomorrow, so I study tonight.

entries.definition_en: to use your mind
entries.example_en: I think English is fun.
entries.example_vi: Mình nghĩ tiếng Anh vui lắm.
entries.cloze_en: I think English is fun. What about you?

entries.definition_en: to look at something for some time
entries.example_en: We watch cartoons on Sunday morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng Chủ nhật tụi mình xem hoạt hình.
entries.cloze_en: We watch cartoons on TV on Sunday morning.

entries.definition_en: to hear songs or music on purpose
entries.example_en: I listen to music on the bus.
entries.example_vi: Mình nghe nhạc trên xe buýt.
entries.cloze_en: I listen to music on my phone on the bus.

entries.definition_en: to make words on paper or on a screen
entries.example_en: Write your name at the top of the page.
entries.example_vi: Viết tên em ở đầu trang nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Write your name at the top of the page with a pen.

entries.definition_en: to pay attention to sounds or to what someone says
entries.example_en: Please listen to the teacher.
entries.example_vi: Các em hãy lắng nghe cô giáo.
entries.cloze_en: Please listen to the teacher. She is talking.

entries.definition_en: a thin wooden thing you write or draw with
entries.example_en: I draw with a pencil first.
entries.example_vi: Mình vẽ bằng bút chì trước.
entries.cloze_en: I draw a cat with a pencil first, and then I color it.

entries.definition_en: a place where children go to learn
entries.example_en: Our school has a big library.
entries.example_vi: Trường mình có một thư viện lớn.
entries.cloze_en: Our school has thirty classrooms and a big library.

entries.definition_en: a game where two teams kick a ball into a goal
entries.example_en: My brother watches soccer on TV every weekend.
entries.example_vi: Cuối tuần nào anh mình cũng xem bóng đá trên TV.
entries.cloze_en: My brother watches soccer on TV every weekend. His team wins.

entries.definition_en: a drawing, painting or photo
entries.example_en: There is a picture of my family on the wall.
entries.example_vi: Trên tường có một bức tranh về gia đình mình.
entries.cloze_en: There is a picture of my family on the wall.

entries.definition_en: a person who studies at a school
entries.example_en: Every student has a name card.
entries.example_vi: Mỗi học sinh đều có một thẻ tên.
entries.cloze_en: Every student in my class has a book and a pen.

entries.definition_en: a person whose job is to teach
entries.example_en: Our English teacher is very kind.
entries.example_vi: Cô giáo tiếng Anh của tụi mình rất hiền.
entries.cloze_en: Our English teacher helps us learn new words every day.

entries.definition_en: a machine for writing, games and the internet
entries.example_en: My dad works on his computer at home.
entries.example_vi: Bố mình làm việc trên máy tính ở nhà.
entries.cloze_en: My dad works on his computer and sends emails.

entries.definition_en: school work that you do at home
entries.example_en: Our teacher gives us a lot of homework.
entries.example_vi: Cô giáo cho tụi mình nhiều bài tập về nhà.
entries.cloze_en: Our teacher gives us a lot of homework to do at home.

entries.definition_en: to take part in a game of soccer
entries.example_en: We play soccer after school on Friday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Sáu tan học tụi mình đá bóng.
entries.cloze_en: We play soccer in the field after school on Friday.

entries.definition_en: not easy to do or understand
entries.example_en: This math question is difficult.
entries.example_vi: Câu hỏi toán này khó.
entries.cloze_en: This math question is very difficult. Nobody knows the answer.

entries.definition_en: drawing, painting and making beautiful things
entries.example_en: We draw flowers in art class.
entries.example_vi: Trong giờ mỹ thuật tụi mình vẽ hoa.
entries.cloze_en: We draw and paint flowers in art class.

entries.definition_en: to be the best in a game or race
entries.example_en: Our team wins the game today.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay đội mình thắng trận.
entries.cloze_en: Our team plays very well, so we win the game.

entries.definition_en: needing a lot of effort
entries.example_en: The last question is really hard.
entries.example_vi: Câu hỏi cuối thật khó nhằn.
entries.cloze_en: The last question is really hard. I don't know the answer.

entries.definition_en: to push yourself up into the air with your legs
entries.example_en: The kids jump rope at break time.
entries.example_vi: Giờ ra chơi bọn trẻ nhảy dây.
entries.cloze_en: The frog can jump very high, from the ground to a big stone.

entries.definition_en: new information about things that happen
entries.example_en: My grandpa watches the news every evening.
entries.example_vi: Tối nào ông cũng xem thời sự.
entries.cloze_en: My grandpa watches the news on TV every evening.

entries.definition_en: one side of a sheet of paper in a book
entries.example_en: Please open your book to page ten.
entries.example_vi: Các em mở sách trang mười nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Please open your book to page ten.

entries.definition_en: a group of people who play or work together
entries.example_en: Our class team plays basketball on Friday.
entries.example_vi: Đội của lớp mình chơi bóng rổ vào thứ Sáu.
entries.cloze_en: There are eleven players on our soccer team.

entries.definition_en: a set of questions to see what you know
entries.example_en: We have an English test next Monday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Hai tuần sau tụi mình có bài kiểm tra tiếng Anh.
entries.cloze_en: We have an English test next Monday, so we study a lot.

entries.definition_en: real; not false
entries.example_en: Is the story in this book true?
entries.example_vi: Câu chuyện trong sách này có thật không?
entries.cloze_en: Is it true that you have a new dog?

entries.definition_en: words a teacher says before a lesson starts
entries.example_en: Open your book and look at the picture.
entries.example_vi: Mở sách ra và nhìn bức tranh nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Open your book to page ten and read the first story.

entries.definition_en: a set of moves you do to music
entries.example_en: Our class learns a new dance for the school party.
entries.example_vi: Lớp mình tập một điệu múa mới cho buổi tiệc của trường.
entries.cloze_en: Our class learns a new dance for the school party.

entries.definition_en: to move your body to music
entries.example_en: My sister loves to dance.
entries.example_vi: Chị mình rất thích nhảy múa.
entries.cloze_en: My sister loves to dance to fast music.

entries.definition_en: something you like to do in your free time
entries.example_en: My hobby is drawing animals.
entries.example_vi: Sở thích của mình là vẽ con vật.
entries.cloze_en: My hobby is drawing animals. I do it every weekend.

entries.definition_en: to put color on something with a brush
entries.example_en: We paint pictures of the sea in art class.
entries.example_vi: Trong giờ mỹ thuật tụi mình vẽ tranh biển.
entries.cloze_en: We paint pictures of the sea in art class.

entries.definition_en: thin white material you write or draw on
entries.example_en: Take a piece of paper and a pencil.
entries.example_vi: Lấy một tờ giấy và một cây bút chì nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Take a piece of paper and a pencil to write.

entries.definition_en: a large music instrument with black and white keys
entries.example_en: Mai plays the piano very well.
entries.example_vi: Mai chơi đàn piano rất giỏi.
entries.cloze_en: Mai plays the piano very well.

entries.definition_en: words about things that happen to people, real or not
entries.example_en: Grandma tells us a funny story.
entries.example_vi: Bà kể cho tụi mình nghe một câu chuyện vui.
entries.cloze_en: Grandma tells us a funny story before bed.

entries.definition_en: to help someone learn something
entries.example_en: Mrs. Lan teaches us English.
entries.example_vi: Cô Lan dạy tụi mình tiếng Anh.
entries.cloze_en: Mrs. Lan is a teacher. She likes to teach us English.

entries.definition_en: moving pictures you watch on a screen
entries.example_en: We make a short video about our school.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình làm một video ngắn về trường.
entries.cloze_en: We make a short video about our school with my phone.

entries.definition_en: not correct
entries.example_en: Sorry, that answer is wrong.
entries.example_vi: Rất tiếc, câu trả lời đó sai rồi.
entries.cloze_en: Sorry, that answer is wrong. Two and two is four, not five.

entries.definition_en: words you say when you will meet someone the next day
entries.example_en: Bye, Lan! See you tomorrow at school.
entries.example_vi: Tạm biệt Lan! Mai gặp lại ở trường nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Bye, Lan! See you tomorrow at school.

entries.definition_en: what you say or write when someone asks a question
entries.example_en: Write your answers in the box.
entries.example_vi: Viết câu trả lời vào ô nhé.
entries.cloze_en: I don't know the answer to this question.

entries.definition_en: to say or write something back to a question
entries.example_en: Please answer the question in English.
entries.example_vi: Các em trả lời câu hỏi bằng tiếng Anh nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Please answer the question in English.

entries.definition_en: not interesting
entries.example_en: This movie is long and boring.
entries.example_vi: Bộ phim này dài và chán.
entries.cloze_en: This movie is long and boring. I want to go home.

entries.definition_en: a music instrument with six strings
entries.example_en: My cousin plays the guitar at parties.
entries.example_vi: Anh họ mình chơi ghi-ta ở các buổi tiệc.
entries.cloze_en: My cousin plays the guitar and sings at parties.

entries.definition_en: a time when someone teaches you something
entries.example_en: Our English lesson starts at nine.
entries.example_vi: Tiết tiếng Anh của tụi mình bắt đầu lúc chín giờ.
entries.cloze_en: Our English lesson starts at nine in Room 5.

entries.definition_en: one of the signs like A, B or C in words
entries.example_en: There are twenty-six letters in English.
entries.example_vi: Tiếng Anh có hai mươi sáu chữ cái.
entries.cloze_en: The first letter of the word "apple" is A.

entries.definition_en: a person who plays a game or sport
entries.example_en: He is the best player on our team.
entries.example_vi: Bạn ấy là cầu thủ giỏi nhất đội mình.
entries.cloze_en: Nam is the best player on our soccer team.

entries.definition_en: a game where players hit a ball over a net
entries.example_en: My dad plays tennis on Sunday.
entries.example_vi: Chủ nhật bố mình chơi quần vợt.
entries.cloze_en: Tennis is a sport with a small ball for two or four players.

entries.definition_en: a funny movie made with drawings
entries.example_en: My little brother loves cartoons about animals.
entries.example_vi: Em trai mình mê phim hoạt hình về con vật.
entries.cloze_en: My little brother loves to watch a cartoon about animals on TV.

entries.definition_en: right; with no mistakes
entries.example_en: All your answers are correct. Well done!
entries.example_vi: Tất cả câu trả lời của em đều đúng. Giỏi lắm!
entries.cloze_en: All your answers are correct. Well done!

entries.definition_en: something that shows what other things are like
entries.example_en: Can you give me an example?
entries.example_vi: Bạn cho mình một ví dụ được không?
entries.cloze_en: "Dog" is an example of an animal.

entries.definition_en: to answer questions to show what you know
entries.example_en: We take a test every Friday.
entries.example_vi: Thứ Sáu nào tụi mình cũng làm bài kiểm tra.
entries.cloze_en: Study hard tonight. We take a test in math tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: the study of things that happened in the past
entries.example_en: We learn about Vietnam's history in class.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình học lịch sử Việt Nam trên lớp.
entries.cloze_en: In history class, we learn about Vietnam a long time ago.

entries.definition_en: a place where you can read and borrow books
entries.example_en: I borrow two books from the library every week.
entries.example_vi: Tuần nào mình cũng mượn hai quyển sách ở thư viện.
entries.cloze_en: I read books in the quiet library near my school.

entries.definition_en: the activity of looking at and understanding words
entries.example_en: Reading is good for your English.
entries.example_vi: Đọc sách rất tốt cho việc học tiếng Anh.
entries.cloze_en: Reading books is good for your English.

entries.definition_en: the study of nature and how things work
entries.example_en: In science class, we learn about plants.
entries.example_vi: Trong giờ khoa học tụi mình học về cây cối.
entries.cloze_en: In science class, we learn about plants and animals.

entries.definition_en: something you learn at school, like math or art
entries.example_en: What is your favorite subject?
entries.example_vi: Môn học bạn thích nhất là gì?
entries.cloze_en: Math is my favorite subject at school.

entries.definition_en: the system that connects computers around the world
entries.example_en: I look for information on the internet.
entries.example_vi: Mình tìm thông tin trên mạng internet.
entries.cloze_en: I send emails and watch videos on the internet.

entries.definition_en: the words people use to speak and write, like English
entries.example_en: How many languages can you speak?
entries.example_vi: Bạn nói được bao nhiêu ngôn ngữ?
entries.cloze_en: English is a language. I can speak it a little.

entries.definition_en: a book with empty pages for writing
entries.example_en: Write the new words in your notebook.
entries.example_vi: Viết các từ mới vào vở nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Write the new words in your notebook.

entries.definition_en: to do something many times to get better
entries.example_en: I practice English with my friends.
entries.example_vi: Mình luyện tiếng Anh với bạn bè.
entries.cloze_en: I practice English with my friends every day.

entries.definition_en: a group of words that tells a full idea
entries.example_en: Make a sentence with the word happy.
entries.example_vi: Đặt một câu với từ happy nhé.
entries.cloze_en: "I like cats." is a sentence with three words.

entries.definition_en: to put your hand up to ask or answer in class
entries.example_en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
entries.example_vi: Em nào biết câu trả lời thì giơ tay nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.

entries.definition_en: a person in the same class as you
entries.example_en: Minh is my classmate and my best friend.
entries.example_vi: Minh là bạn cùng lớp và cũng là bạn thân của mình.
entries.cloze_en: Minh is my classmate. We are in the same class.

entries.definition_en: a room where students have lessons
entries.example_en: Our classroom is on the third floor.
entries.example_vi: Phòng học của tụi mình ở tầng ba.
entries.cloze_en: Our classroom has thirty desks and a TV for lessons.

entries.definition_en: a game where players throw a ball through a high ring
entries.example_en: Tall students often play basketball.
entries.example_vi: Các bạn cao thường chơi bóng rổ.
entries.cloze_en: Tall students like to play basketball with a big orange ball.

entries.definition_en: a book that tells you what words mean
entries.example_en: Look up new words in your dictionary.
entries.example_vi: Tra từ mới trong từ điển nhé.
entries.cloze_en: When I don't know a word, I look it up in my dictionary.

entries.definition_en: making you want to know more
entries.example_en: This book about animals is very interesting.
entries.example_vi: Quyển sách về con vật này rất thú vị.
entries.cloze_en: This book about animals is very interesting. I can't stop reading.
